We are offering at auction this historic original Mister Douglas t-shirt from 1976. Thanks Larry for preserving it all these years, and donating it to The Mr. Douglas Society Inc. After talking to the designer Karen McClarty in DeLand, FL as to the t-shirts history, we believe it to be the first t-shirt promoting this historic aircraft. So we had Karen sign it and dated it. 
Just place your bid in the comment section and hopefully you'll be the one to receive this beautiful t-shirt.

The size is a medium and it may have shrunk a little. LOL
